newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: IMF team says Philippines economy impressive.
newsitem.headline: IMF team says Philippines economy impressive.

text.p: An International Monetary Fund (IMF) review team was impressed by the Philippines' strong economic growth, the team said on Thursday in a joint statement with the Philippine Central Bank.
"The strong performance of the Philippine economy so far in 1996 impressed the IMF team," the statement said.

"Economic expansion has been sustained for a third year, helping to lift the Philippines towards the ranks of the fast growing industrialising countries and paving the way for progress on the social reform agenda," it added.

"The Philippine authorities and the IMF team agreed that a strong and meaningful tax reform is critical -- not only to secure the gains made in the fiscal accounts in recent years, but also to permit an expansion of infrastructure spending and national savings," it added.
The comprehensive tax reform package, which is currently being deliberated in the Philippine Senate, is aimed at simplifying the tax structure and plugging loopholes in the excise tax system.
